gaps.sentence: He behaves as if he were ___ owner of the company.
gaps.explanation: 'The owner' — there is one owner, so 'the'.

gaps.sentence: ___ rich variety of birds lives in the Danube delta.
gaps.explanation: A rich variety of… — variety is countable here, first mention.

gaps.sentence: Mount Everest is ___ highest mountain in the world.
The charity provides ___ shelter for homeless families in winter.
gaps.explanation: 'Shelter' is uncountable and general here, so no article is used.

gaps.sentence: We go to ___ cinema about once a month.
gaps.explanation: 'Go to the cinema/theatre' is a fixed phrase with 'the'.

gaps.sentence: The thief was sent to ___ prison for three years.
gaps.explanation: 'Sent to prison' — the institution, no article; 'the prison' would mean the building.

gaps.sentence: He left ___ school at sixteen and went straight into a job.
gaps.explanation: Leave school (finish education) takes no article.
